verdict.rationale: The firm documents an employment practice that advises on 'all aspects of employment law including litigation, transactional and advisory matters' and on compensation structuring, so drafting hiring paperwork plausibly falls within its own offering. However, none of the specific hiring documents in the story are named. The IP page covers trademarks and patents but not employee invention-assignment or confidentiality agreements. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of drafting offer letters, employment agreements, and invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements; sample engagements or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm prepares hiring paperwork — offer letters, employment agreements, and invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements — as part of a documented employment practice

citations.quote: Our employment team advises clients on all aspects of employment law including litigation, transactional and advisory matters
